rules.title: Rent Control for Multifamily Properties Built Before 1980
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quote: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.summary: Most units in multifamily properties built before June 1980 are subject to rent control in Berkeley.
rules.coverage_text: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980
rules.exemption_note: Excludes units with certain government subsidies; see footnote for government subsidy details.

rules.coverage_text: Single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996
rules.exemption_note: Coverage depends on tenancy start date being before 1996.

rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quote: Units with the following government subsidies regardless of unit type: Section 202 Supportive Housing for the Elderly, Section 811 Supportive Housing for Persons with Disabilities Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction for Units with Rental Supplement/Section 8 LMS/Project-based Section 8 and HUD Mortgage
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quote: Regardless of unit type, units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, Project-based Section 8 subsidies AND in a project with a mortgage insured or held by HUD. Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.summary: Units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, or Project-based Section 8 subsidies in a project with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage require just cause for eviction in Berkeley.
rules.coverage_text: Regardless of unit type, units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, Project-based Section 8 subsidies AND in a project with a mortgage insured or held by HUD
rules.exemption_note: Coverage depends on specific government subsidy types and HUD mortgage.
